imports.source: file line 286, Kowloon III. Imports, 1904 Total column
imports.note: Station column reads 2,810 and the total column OCR reads '24850'. The 1904 comparison column of No. 151 reads '21,8io' (2,810), so 2,810 is entered; the scan should confirm whether the total is 2,810 or 2,850. Comparison columns: 1902 = 4,042 (matches No. 135); 1903 = 2,956.

issue_notes: No. 143 (1904 Q3): Kowloon sulphur only; the Kowloon saltpetre row was not found in the OCR. The Tientsin Native Customs export table lists saltpetre with a 1903 figure (4,289) but none for 1904. Duty-free rows are rice only.

No. 143: Kowloon sulphur changed from 2,850 to 2,810 after comparison with No. 151. No. 151 also gives Kowloon saltpetre for 1904 Q3 as '4,698' with the leading digit lost (probably 14,698); not entered.
